## Goal

Document and roll out the Codex durable-memory operating model for Open Brain.

## Required Content

- How Codex uses Open Brain for short-term session memory.
- How Codex promotes/saves long-term memory.
- When Codex should search memory before answering.
- How memory citations should appear in user-facing answers.
- How this differs from Hermes-style long-running agents.
- How to run the eval suite and interpret failures.
- Security and privacy constraints: namespace isolation, no secrets, no raw transcript dumping.

- Repo docs and local agent instructions are updated.
